seo.description: Business setup, tax and accounting support for trading, e-commerce, technology, consulting, real estate and hospitality businesses in the UAE and UK.

sections.heading: Different businesses, the same advisory standard.
sections.subhead: We work across a handful of industries closely enough to know what actually breaks — not generic advice with your sector name swapped in.

image.alt: Illustrated Dubai waterfront business district with offices, retail, cafe terraces and an international port

sections.statement: Every industry below trades in and out of Dubai for a reason.
sections.body: Fast-moving free zones, real deadlines, and cross-border founders — the same city that makes these businesses possible is the one that makes the paperwork worth getting right.

items.title: E-commerce & Online Retail
items.description: Selling across borders needs a structure that doesn't fight your supply chain — free zone setup, VAT registration, and corporate tax planned around how goods and payments actually move.

items.title: Trading & Import/Export
items.description: Physical goods moving through UAE ports need mainland or free zone structuring matched to how you actually trade, plus the licensing and PRO work that keeps shipments moving.

items.title: Consulting & Professional Services
items.description: Solo consultants and small advisory firms scaling past a freelance permit into a proper licensed entity, often with a UK arm for cross-border clients.

items.title: Technology & SaaS
items.description: Distributed teams, recurring revenue, and investors who ask about your cap table — CFO support and dual UAE/UK structuring built for how software businesses actually grow.

items.title: Real Estate & Holding Companies
items.description: Asset protection and clean ownership structures for property and investment holdings, often through offshore entities built for exactly this purpose.

items.title: Hospitality & F&B
items.description: Licensing, payroll, and VAT for businesses with real premises and real staff — mainland formation done right the first time, and compliance that doesn't lapse.

sections.heading: Ready to talk it through?
sections.description: Book a call with an advisor — no obligation, no sales script, just a clear read on what setup makes sense for your business.
